name: Acrisure Stadium
summary: Acrisure Stadium sits on Pittsburgh's North Shore and is known for its open end facing the downtown skyline.

name: Allegiant Stadium
summary: Allegiant Stadium uses a movable natural grass field tray and sits just west of the Las Vegas Strip.

name: AT&T Stadium
summary: AT&T Stadium is one of the NFL's largest venues by listed football capacity and has a major retractable roof.

name: Bank of America Stadium
summary: Bank of America Stadium anchors uptown Charlotte and is used for NFL, soccer, concerts, and major events.

name: Caesars Superdome
summary: The Caesars Superdome is one of the NFL's most recognizable domed stadiums and a frequent major-event venue.

name: Empower Field at Mile High
summary: Empower Field at Mile High is known for its elevation and sits near downtown Denver.

name: EverBank Stadium
summary: EverBank Stadium sits near the St. Johns River and has hosted NFL games, college football, and international soccer.

name: Ford Field
summary: Ford Field is a downtown Detroit indoor stadium integrated with a former warehouse facade.

name: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium
summary: Arrowhead is one of the NFL's longest-running current stadiums and is famous for crowd noise.

name: Gillette Stadium
summary: Gillette Stadium is part of the Patriot Place development in Foxborough, southwest of Boston.

name: Hard Rock Stadium
summary: Hard Rock Stadium has an open-air canopy and hosts NFL games, college football, tennis, soccer, and concerts.

name: Highmark Stadium
summary: Highmark Stadium is the Bills' new football-first venue in Orchard Park, designed to open for the 2026 NFL season.
future_note: Replaces the former Highmark Stadium used by the Buffalo Bills from 1973 through the 2025 season.

name: Huntington Bank Field
summary: Huntington Bank Field sits on Cleveland's lakefront near the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
future_note: A new enclosed Huntington Bank Field in Brook Park is under construction and is set to become the Browns' home in 2029.

name: Lambeau Field
summary: Lambeau Field is the NFL's oldest continuously used stadium by a current team.

name: Levi's Stadium
summary: Levi's Stadium is in Santa Clara and serves the 49ers in the South Bay rather than inside San Francisco.

name: Lincoln Financial Field
summary: Lincoln Financial Field is part of Philadelphia's South Philadelphia sports complex.

name: Lucas Oil Stadium
summary: Lucas Oil Stadium has a retractable roof and large north-facing window overlooking downtown Indianapolis.

name: Lumen Field
summary: Lumen Field is known for its steep seating bowl and loud football atmosphere near downtown Seattle.

name: M&T Bank Stadium
summary: M&T Bank Stadium is part of Baltimore's Camden Yards sports district.

name: Mercedes-Benz Stadium
summary: Mercedes-Benz Stadium is known for its retractable roof and circular halo video board.

name: MetLife Stadium
teams: New York Giants / New York Jets
summary: MetLife Stadium is shared by the Giants and Jets and is the largest current NFL venue by listed capacity.

name: Nissan Stadium
summary: Nissan Stadium sits across the Cumberland River from downtown Nashville.
future_note: The Titans are building a replacement domed stadium planned for 2027.

name: Northwest Stadium
summary: Northwest Stadium is the Commanders' current home in Landover, Maryland.
future_note: The Commanders have announced a planned new stadium project in Washington, D.C. for 2030.

name: NRG Stadium
summary: NRG Stadium was the NFL's first retractable-roof stadium built for football.

name: Paycor Stadium
summary: Paycor Stadium sits on Cincinnati's riverfront along the Ohio River.

name: Raymond James Stadium
summary: Raymond James Stadium is known for its pirate ship feature and warm-weather open-air design.

name: SoFi Stadium
teams: Los Angeles Rams / Los Angeles Chargers
summary: SoFi Stadium is shared by the Rams and Chargers and anchors the Hollywood Park development in Inglewood.

name: Soldier Field
summary: Soldier Field is the smallest current NFL stadium by listed football capacity and one of the league's oldest venues.
future_note: The Bears continue to explore long-term stadium options in the Chicago area.

name: State Farm Stadium
summary: State Farm Stadium combines a retractable roof with a roll-out natural grass field.

name: U.S. Bank Stadium
summary: U.S. Bank Stadium is an indoor venue with a steep translucent roof near downtown Minneapolis.
